Container.Name: strata
Container.Overview: Strata runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next locally on one NVIDIA card. Web UI plus OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API on port 8080. The image is built locally with build.sh; the first start downloads the ~70 GB model into the data path.
Container.Requires: Nvidia Driver plugin with driver 580 or newer. Build the image first: bash build.sh

Config.Name: Model data
Config.Description: Model, pack, MTP layer and config (~80 GB). Keep it on the NVMe pool: use the /mnt/cache path, not /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Context
Config.Description: Tokens the model keeps in mind

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Set one before exposing the port beyond your LAN

Config.Name: Reinstall
Config.Description: 1 re-runs setup to apply changed Context / Vision / API key. Set back to 0 afterwards.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: all, or the GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin page
